name: Top Bar Menu UI
description: UI sub-spec detailing the DOM structure, menu hierarchy, dropdown behavior, and interaction model of the custom menu bar.

dynamic_submenus.terminal-submenu: Populated by setTerminalItems() with instance title + open/minimized status
dynamic_submenus.git-submenu: Populated by setGitItems() with instance title + open/minimized status
dynamic_submenus.specsmap-submenu: Populated by setSpecsmapItems() with instance title + open/minimized status

interactions.behavior: Opens the dropdown menu; closes all others via closeAllMenus() with 300ms delay on leave
Executes associated callback (e.g., onNewTerminal, onAbout) and closes all menus
Focuses or reopens the corresponding plugin instance by UUID
Calls onGridChange() with the selected style (dots/grid/none) and updates checkmark
Reveals nested dropdown on hover (no click toggle, pure CSS :hover)
Toggles zoom lock state, calls onZoomLock()

states.name: closed
states.description: All dropdowns hidden, no menu item has .open class

states.name: menu-open
states.description: One .menu-item has .open class, its .menu-dropdown is visible

states.name: nested-open
states.description: A .menu-item-nested is hovered, its .menu-dropdown-nested is visible
